title: source-control team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/source-control.yaml, the team layer of the source-control plugin's YAML settings. Each key here wins over the plugin's userConfig value of the same name. Resolution: plugins/source-control/reference/config-resolution.md.

pr_open_state.description: State /source-control:pull-request create leaves a pull request in. ready runs /source-control:pull-request ready on the new pull request, which flips it after its gates; draft leaves it a draft for that action to flip later.

pre_ready.description: Which pre-flip steps /source-control:pull-request ready runs, read at the pull request's base branch. A list of {step, enabled} mappings rather than a mapping keyed by step, so the shared YAML-subset reader reads each item by index. A step the list leaves out runs. The hold checks, the push and the flip are not steps here and always run. Each step appears at most once; the reader runs every step when one repeats, names an unknown step, or the list does not parse.

step.description: base-merge: merge the base into the head. plan-evidence: gather the review evidence a plan's Review: value asks for. code-review and security-review: the fresh-context reviews of the pull request's diff. verify: the verify gate on the merged head.

enabled.description: false skips the step and reports it as disabled by pre_ready at the base branch, never as passing.
